lessons.title: A New Job Offer
lessons.context: A short story about a difficult career decision.

paragraphs.fr: Thomas travaille dans la même entreprise depuis huit ans.
paragraphs.en: Thomas has worked at the same company for eight years.

paragraphs.fr: La semaine dernière, on lui a proposé un poste dans une autre ville, avec un meilleur salaire.
paragraphs.en: Last week, they offered him a position in another city, with a better salary.

paragraphs.fr: Il n'est pas sûr que ce soit une bonne idée de quitter ses amis et sa routine.
paragraphs.en: He's not sure it's a good idea to leave his friends and his routine.

paragraphs.fr: Sa femme lui a dit qu'il fallait qu'il pense à son avenir, pas seulement au présent.
paragraphs.en: His wife told him he needed to think about his future, not just the present.

paragraphs.fr: Il n'a pas encore décidé quoi faire, mais il doit répondre avant vendredi.
paragraphs.en: He still hasn't decided what to do, but he has to respond by Friday.

questions.question: How long has Thomas worked at his company?
What did they offer him last week?
options: A promotion at the same office

questions.question: Why is Thomas unsure?
options: He would have to leave his friends and routine
He doesn't like the new city

questions.question: By when does he need to respond?

lessons.title: The Neighborhood That Changed
lessons.context: A reflective story using the plus-que-parfait to describe change.

paragraphs.fr: Quand Julie est retournée dans son ancien quartier, elle ne l'a presque pas reconnu.
paragraphs.en: When Julie returned to her old neighborhood, she almost didn't recognize it.

paragraphs.fr: Ils avaient construit plusieurs nouveaux bâtiments là où il y avait autrefois de petites maisons.
paragraphs.en: They had built several new buildings where there used to be small houses.

paragraphs.fr: Le magasin où elle achetait des bonbons enfant avait déjà fermé depuis des années.
paragraphs.en: The store where she used to buy candy as a child had already closed years ago.

paragraphs.fr: Pourtant, le parc où elle jouait était resté exactement le même.
paragraphs.en: However, the park where she used to play was still exactly the same.

paragraphs.fr: Elle s'est assise sur un banc et s'est souvenue de tout ce qu'elle avait vécu là-bas.
paragraphs.en: She sat on a bench and remembered everything she had experienced there.

questions.question: What happened when Julie returned to her neighborhood?
What had they built?
What had already closed?
options: The store where she bought candy

questions.question: What stayed the same?
options: The park where she used to play

lessons.title: Advice for a Younger Sibling
lessons.titleNative: Des conseils pour un petit frère
lessons.context: A short dialogue-style story built around the subjunctive.

paragraphs.fr: Mon petit frère va commencer l'université cette année.
paragraphs.en: My younger brother is going to start college this year.

paragraphs.fr: Je lui ai dit qu'il était important qu'il organise bien son temps dès le début.
paragraphs.en: I told him it's important that he organize his time well from the start.

paragraphs.fr: Je lui ai aussi suggéré de parler à ses professeurs s'il a des doutes.
paragraphs.en: I also suggested that he talk to his professors if he has questions.

paragraphs.fr: J'espère qu'il se fera de nouveaux amis et qu'il profitera de cette nouvelle étape.
paragraphs.en: I hope he makes new friends and enjoys this new stage.

paragraphs.fr: Je sais qu'il va réussir parce qu'il a toujours été très responsable.
paragraphs.en: I know he's going to succeed because he has always been very responsible.

questions.question: What is the younger brother about to start?
What did the writer say is important?
What did the writer suggest?
options: Talking to professors if he has questions

questions.question: Why does the writer believe he'll succeed?
options: He has always been very responsible
He has a lot of money

lessons.title: A Long Friendship
lessons.context: A short story using depuis, pendant, and il y a naturally.

paragraphs.fr: Marie et Claire sont amies depuis l'école primaire.
paragraphs.en: Marie and Claire have been friends since elementary school.

paragraphs.fr: Elles se sont rencontrées il y a plus de vingt-cinq ans, dans la même classe.
paragraphs.en: They met more than twenty-five years ago, in the same class.

paragraphs.fr: Claire a vécu à l'étranger pendant cinq ans, mais elles n'ont jamais perdu contact.
paragraphs.en: Claire lived abroad for five years, but they never lost touch.

paragraphs.fr: Depuis son retour, elles se voient presque chaque semaine.
paragraphs.en: Since her return, they see each other almost every week.

paragraphs.fr: Une amitié qui dure depuis si longtemps est vraiment précieuse.
paragraphs.en: A friendship that has lasted so long is truly precious.

questions.question: Since when have Marie and Claire been friends?
How long ago did they meet?
How long did Claire live abroad?
How often do they see each other now?

lessons.title: The Best Teacher I've Had
lessons.titleNative: Le meilleur professeur que j'aie eu
lessons.context: A reflective story combining relative clauses and subjunctive.

paragraphs.fr: De tous les professeurs que j'ai eus, monsieur Dubois était le meilleur.
paragraphs.en: Of all the teachers I've had, Mr. Dubois was the best.

paragraphs.fr: C'était un homme qui expliquait toujours les choses avec beaucoup de patience.
paragraphs.en: He was a man who always explained things with a lot of patience.

paragraphs.fr: Je n'ai jamais oublié la façon dont il nous a appris à penser par nous-mêmes.
paragraphs.en: I've never forgotten the way he taught us to think for ourselves.

paragraphs.fr: Les élèves qui ont eu la chance d'être dans sa classe se souviennent de lui avec affection.
paragraphs.en: The students who had the luck of being in his class remember him fondly.

paragraphs.fr: J'espère qu'un jour je pourrai le remercier pour tout ce qu'il a fait pour moi.
paragraphs.en: I hope that someday I can thank him for everything he did for me.

questions.question: Who was the best teacher the writer has had?
How did Mr. Dubois explain things?
What did he teach the students to do?
What does the writer hope to do someday?
options: Thank him for everything he did

lessons.title: Preparing for a Job Interview
lessons.titleNative: Se préparer pour un entretien d'embauche
lessons.context: A short story about interview preparation.

paragraphs.fr: Demain, j'ai un entretien pour le travail que j'avais toujours voulu.
paragraphs.en: Tomorrow I have an interview for the job I had always wanted.

paragraphs.fr: Il faut que j'arrive tôt et que j'apporte tous mes documents.
paragraphs.en: It's necessary that I arrive early and bring all my documents.

paragraphs.fr: Un ami qui travaille dans le même secteur m'a donné plusieurs conseils utiles.
paragraphs.en: A friend who works in the same industry gave me several useful tips.

paragraphs.fr: J'ai pratiqué mes réponses devant le miroir pendant toute la semaine.
paragraphs.en: I've practiced my answers in front of the mirror all week.

paragraphs.fr: Je suis nerveux, mais aussi très content de cette opportunité.
paragraphs.en: I'm nervous, but also excited about this opportunity.

questions.question: What does the writer have tomorrow?
What is necessary according to the writer?
options: Arriving early and bringing all documents

questions.question: Who gave the writer advice?
options: A friend who works in the same industry

questions.question: How does the writer feel?

lessons.title: A Weekend in the Mountains
lessons.context: A story about a weekend trip, mixing past tenses.

paragraphs.fr: Le week-end dernier, nous sommes allés à la montagne, un endroit que nous n'avions jamais visité.
paragraphs.en: Last weekend we went to the mountains, a place we had never visited.

paragraphs.fr: Quand nous sommes arrivés, il avait déjà commencé à neiger un peu.
paragraphs.en: When we arrived, it had already started to snow a little.

paragraphs.fr: Nous avons marché sur des sentiers qui offraient des vues incroyables sur la vallée.
paragraphs.en: We walked along trails that offered incredible views of the valley.

paragraphs.fr: Le soir, nous nous sommes assis près du feu pour nous réchauffer.
paragraphs.en: At night, we sat by the fire to warm up.

paragraphs.fr: Ce fut l'un des voyages les plus agréables que nous ayons faits depuis des années.
paragraphs.en: It has been one of the most pleasant trips we've taken in years.

questions.question: Had they visited the mountains before?
What had already started when they arrived?
What did the trails offer?
How does the writer describe the trip?
options: One of the most relaxing trips in years

lessons.title: Volunteering at the Shelter
lessons.context: A story about community service, using the subjunctive and past tenses.

paragraphs.fr: Depuis un an, je travaille comme bénévole dans un refuge pour animaux.
paragraphs.en: For a year now, I've worked as a volunteer at an animal shelter.

paragraphs.fr: Il faut que plus de gens adoptent les animaux qu'ils sauvent.
paragraphs.en: It's necessary that more people adopt the animals they rescue.

paragraphs.fr: Chaque chien et chat qui arrive a une histoire différente et difficile.
paragraphs.en: Each dog and cat that arrives has a different, difficult story.

paragraphs.fr: Je suis content que de plus en plus de familles décident d'adopter plutôt que d'acheter.
paragraphs.en: I'm glad that more and more families are deciding to adopt instead of buy.

paragraphs.fr: Ce travail m'a appris la valeur de la patience et de la compassion.
paragraphs.en: This work has taught me the value of patience and compassion.

questions.question: How long has the writer volunteered at the shelter?
What is necessary according to the writer?
What is the writer glad about?
options: More families choosing to adopt instead of buy

questions.question: What has this work taught the writer?
options: The value of patience and compassion

lessons.title: The Letter I Never Sent
lessons.titleNative: La lettre que je n'ai jamais envoyée
lessons.context: A reflective, slightly emotional story about regret and relative clauses.

paragraphs.fr: Il y a des années, j'ai écrit une lettre à une personne à qui je n'avais jamais dit la vérité.
paragraphs.en: Years ago I wrote a letter for a person to whom I never told the truth.

paragraphs.fr: J'y expliquais tout ce que j'avais ressenti mais n'avais jamais exprimé à voix haute.
paragraphs.en: In it I explained everything I had felt but had never expressed out loud.

paragraphs.fr: Finalement, j'ai décidé de ne pas l'envoyer parce que j'avais peur de sa réaction.
paragraphs.en: In the end, I decided not to send it because I was afraid of her reaction.

paragraphs.fr: Maintenant que tant de temps a passé, je me demande parfois ce qui se serait passé.
paragraphs.en: Now that so much time has passed, sometimes I wonder what would have happened.

paragraphs.fr: Il est probable que je ne connaisse jamais la réponse, mais au moins j'ai appris à être plus honnête.
paragraphs.en: It's likely I'll never know the answer, but at least I learned to be more honest.

questions.question: What did the writer never do?
Why didn't the writer send the letter?
What does the writer wonder now?
What did the writer learn from this experience?

lessons.title: Looking Back on the Year
lessons.context: A capstone reflective story reviewing B1's key grammar in context.

paragraphs.fr: Cette année a été pleine de changements que je n'avais jamais imaginés.
paragraphs.en: This year has been full of changes I had never imagined.

paragraphs.fr: J'ai appris à faire confiance aux personnes qui me soutiennent vraiment.
paragraphs.en: I've learned to trust more in the people who truly support me.

paragraphs.fr: J'espère que l'année prochaine apportera autant de bonnes surprises que celle-ci.
paragraphs.en: I hope next year brings as many good surprises as this one.

paragraphs.fr: La ville où j'habite maintenant est devenue un vrai foyer pour moi.
paragraphs.en: The city where I now live has become a true home for me.

paragraphs.fr: En regardant en arrière, je me rends compte que chaque défi m'a rendu plus fort.
paragraphs.en: Looking back, I realize that every challenge has made me stronger.

questions.question: How does the writer describe this year?
What has the writer learned to do?
options: Trust more in people who truly support them

questions.question: What has the city where they live become?
What realization does the writer have looking back?
options: Every challenge has made them stronger
